User Radar public-source components (local integration)

1. extruct 0.18.0
Upstream: https://github.com/scrapinghub/extruct
License: BSD-3-Clause; retained upstream LICENSE and provenance under extruct/.
Integration: JSON-LD and Microdata Person extraction in structured_contacts.py.
Only local parsing is enabled. No remote RDFa/context retrieval.
Name, role, individual email, mobile and explicit WhatsApp remain separately verified.

2. theHarvester 4.8.2 email parser
Upstream: https://github.com/laramies/theHarvester
Commit: b9eeef90cb5ae960abf8ccae874bba6673c1c688
License: GPL-2.0; retained text and source provenance under theHarvester/.
Scope: unchanged parsers/myparser.py, executed via standalone email_worker.py.
Input: public documents already independently read by User Radar.
Output: domain email hints, always initially unqualified.
The adapter filters suffix-domain false positives and requires original same-person
name+role+email evidence before qualification. The full network-engine suite,
DNS recon, scans and paid API sources are not installed or enabled.
No person is inferred from an email local part. No WhatsApp inferred from phone.

Runtime license text: see component LICENSE files and installed package metadata.

3. website-email-contact-scraper local email parser
Upstream: https://github.com/omkarcloud/website-email-contact-scraper
Commit: d6a92b92f08a9740535de5f2dd6c6fb27ad7a0d8
License: MIT; retained LICENSE, unmodified parsing modules and hashes under
website_email_contact_scraper/. No upstream crawler, aggregate ranking,
Chrome installer, network API or package install scripts are used.
Adapter website_email_bridge.py decodes explicit public email spellings within
the original DOM scope and retains original spellings/method. All upstream
page email outputs are unqualified leads, still independently verified.
No mobile or WhatsApp behavior or company contact ranking is imported.
